summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py (thread-entry state initialized in the constructor, set and cleared in the run_app coroutine's try/finally) and added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 9 tests. All 9 pass when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at this repo's src, because the shared venv imports textual from a separate base checkout. Regression check: test_auto_pilot, test_unmount, and test_message_pump pass; async-def tests in test_call_later.py and test_screens.py fail due to the venv's pytest asyncio setup, unrelated to this change. Nothing committed; the venv was not modified.
